app.title: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
app.author: snehesht
app.description: Strata is a lightweight inference framework that runs Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer GPUs such as RTX 4090, aiming for high throughput with minimal setup.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and install dependencies via pip
Run the provided inference script on a sample prompt and verify output
Measure token generation latency and compare with vLLM baseline
Benchmark throughput by generating 100 tokens and calculate tokens/second
